arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Casey argued the lower courts erred. He stated the case does not involve lawyers or clergy.
Ms. Labelle clarified the administrative proceedings. She described the three-day trial and preliminary injunction.
Mr. Lamken argued the rules fit inmate status. He said the limits serve legitimate penological interests.
